## pluggable_component

```yaml
name: plan
return_type: PlanResult
signature_template: plan(start, goal, environment, dynamics, seed, *paradigm_extras_by_name)
  -> PlanResult
contract:
  fixed_positional_args:
  - start
  - goal
  - environment
  - dynamics
  seed_param: seed
  paradigm_extras_forwarding: by_name_from_config
  forbidden_param_names:
  - config
return_type_definition: 'PlanResult is a dataclass / namedtuple with fields:

  - trajectory: Trajectory | None

  - status: Literal["success", "timeout", "infeasible", "error"]

  - stats: Dict[str, Any]

  '
rationale: 'The notebook calls the planner on a concrete start/goal/environment

  problem and visualizes the returned trajectory when status is success.

  Method-specific hyperparameters are forwarded by name from params.

  '
```

## smoke_bugs

```yaml
- id: dynamics_step_shape_mismatch
  status: seed
  description: dynamics.step returns a state with the wrong rank or dimension count.
- id: collision_check_too_strict
  status: seed
  description: The collision model rejects every candidate state or edge.
- id: planner_no_path_found
  status: seed
  description: The planner exhausts its time/iteration budget and returns no path.
- id: state_bounds_violation
  status: seed
  description: Sampled or propagated states escape the environment state bounds.
- id: control_dim_mismatch
  status: seed
  description: The planner samples controls whose dimension does not match the dynamics.
```
